reviews.t: Perfect for toddlers! Truly Ouchless!
reviews.x: My two-year daughter hated having her hair brushed and screamed every time I attempted to do that, UNTIL we I bought this brush. It's truly does not pull the hair, unravels knots and sticky places quickly and more or less painlessly, and in general makes for a much more pleasant experience. I can now brush my daughter's hair in peace and do it for as long as necessary without any complaints form her.

reviews.t: Leaves hair frizzy AND tangled
reviews.x: I'm with the previous reviewer, I don't understand this brush/the good reviews at all. I was skeptical as soon as I opened it, but since it can't be returned after opening (and it's in a cardboard box so you can't see it until you open it), I gave it a shot. Its weird, flimsy bristles do nothing for my hair except make it frizz like crazy. It didn't begin to touch the tangles, just turned my hair into a frizzy, tangled mess rather than a smooth tangled mess. If this was returnable I absolutely w

reviews.t: ... probably 10 of these brushes for all those I love and they too are smitten with them
reviews.x: I have now bought probably 10 of these brushes for all those I love and they too are smitten with them.  It makes combing out wet or tangled hair so much easier.  It does not tear as much hair out as others.  It feels great on the scalp.  It is the only brush I use anymore.

reviews.t: OK DETANGLER, BAD FOR YOUR ENDS
reviews.x: I WAS IN LOVE AT FIRST UNTIL I REALIZED THAT THIS WAS SHREDDING MY NATURAL HAIR. IT CAUSES SPLIT ENDS AND BROKEN ENDS. THE THING I HATED MOST WAS THE HANDLE AND OVERALL GRIP OF THE BRUSH, THIS WAS NOT MADE TO HANDLE A LOT OF HAIR. IT EITHER SLIPPED OUT OF MY HAND OR I HAD TO WIPE MY HANDS FIRST THEN PROCEED TO BRUSH, IF YOU HAVE THIN HAIR THIS IS YOUR DEAL BUT BE AWARE OF THE ENDS OF YOUR HAIR WHILE USING.

reviews.t: the best brush ever!!!
reviews.x: This is the greatest brush ever.  I have short thick curly hair, and it can knot up   this brush goes thru it like nothung.  I had my daughter try it and hair is long, extremely thick and curly.  just awesome did fir her hair what it did for mine.  she loves it I went back and ord er ed her one of her own. the colors are fun and bright  Makes it easy to find amongst my other things. Thank you crave for such a great product. great stocking stuffer!!!

reviews.t: Works wonderfully for me!
reviews.x: I was a bit skeptical when I bought this, I get bad snarls in the back of my hair regularly, but I tried this and it actually works!  The bristles have a little 'give' to them, they are not rigid and I think this helps with the knots and detangling.  I am pleasantly surprised and not agonizing about having to brush out my hair anymore.

reviews.t: but the short flexible bristles are still sturdy enough to get to the scalp (nice scalp massage
reviews.x: After trying all sorts of different types of so-called "detangling" brushes on the market, I finally found one that worked for me! Takes about a minute to get all the kinks & tangles out in the morning instead of five minutes spent just on combing. On the plus side, it is very gentle and doesn't pull at hair of various textures. I relax my naturally curly/wavy hair every few months, so when its on the new growth stage things can get dicey, but the short flexible bristles are still sturdy

reviews.t: We Own Four of These
reviews.x: I have purchased four of these brushes.  Bought one for my 8 year-old daughter last year as her everything brush (wet, dry...) and it ended the post-wash struggles of trying to comb through the knots.  (The cleansing conditioner we started using may have helped a bit as well).  I found myself constantly borrowing her brush so I got one for myself.  I recently started driving a Jeep and realized I will need one to keep in the car for when the top is off.  Of course my daughter started constantly

reviews.t: Put that scissor down, wipe your tears, and give this brush a try.
reviews.x: I have waist-length hair that has an almost hay-like texture (from denying my Asian straight black hair and bleaching the living crap out of it), and always gets extremely tangled at the nape of my neck, especially after I recently moved to a dry desert highland. Detangling time to me involves ibuprofen, cursing, tears, regret, and debates whether I would look good with a bowl cut. One fateful night, as I was holding my scissor, mascara and black eyeliner running down my face, my hands about to

reviews.t: Like magic!
reviews.x: I don't know what I did without this brush before. I have naturally dark hair that I have colored blonde so my hair is dry, brittle and tangles very easily. Before I had to use nearly an entire bottle of conditioner just to make my hair manageable post shower. Now I barely use any conditioner. I use a detangling / leave-in conditioner spray (Unite 7 Seconds is awesome by the way) and then I brush through with this brush and it goes through without ripping out my hair and getting stuck. It's not

reviews.t: An OK brush, but my 2yo still dislikes getting his hair brushed.
reviews.x: I bought this brush for my 2yo son's out-of-control curly hair.  He constantly has knots in it, and I need something a little more functional than a soft-bristled brush in order to get his tangles out. Plus, his favorite color is currently green, so I got him a green brush in the hopes that he would actually want me to brush his hair.  1.  This brush does get surface tangles out, but because it is intended to be a gentle brush it takes some work to get some of the tangles out. 2.  My son still r

reviews.t: Very happy!
reviews.x: I absolutely love this brush!  I have very long, frizzy, and wavy hair.  I had a Wet brush for about 3-4 years that I really liked but the bristles were all bent and they wouldn't go all the way through my wet or dry hair and seemed to make more knots.  This brush is light to hold and works out any knots very easily so no more brushing my hair until my shoulder hurts and my hand cramps.  The bristles aren't metal so they wont bend.  Extremely happy with this purchase!

reviews.t: Not magical, but definitely helpful!
reviews.x: I bought this brush for my toddler. She has very fine hair and it's always getting tangled, but she is pretty intolerant of my detangling attempts. Although this brush can't make every knot painless, it is very helpful! The material and shape of the brush prevents snags and the give in the bristles allows me to work through those knots without accidentally ripping her hair or hurting her. I plan on buying a second!

reviews.t: thick hair that tangles easily and she cries when it's brushed
reviews.x: I bought this as a stocking stuffer for my 5-year old niece who has very long, thick hair that tangles easily and she cries when it's brushed. This brush doesn't look of feel like its sturdy enough to really gently detangle hair, but it does. The tines are very flexible so that it doesn't pull the hair. And the tines aren't all in straight rows. I'm not sure how it works, but it does. And that makes us all happy!

reviews.t: This is a great product! My two friends had this brush and ...
reviews.x: Attached is a picture of me (black hair) shortly after combing my hair with this. This is a great product! My two friends had this brush and allowed me to try theirs out. I bought my own and love it! I have curly hair and when I straighten it, I have trouble combing through the curls. This brush handles well and gets all the knots out.

reviews.t: THis is the 2nd one I've got since I love it so much
reviews.x: If you don't have one, you need one. What a difference it makes brushing my hair after a shower. Because I am able to brush it straight before drying, it dries straighter and with no tangles. This is new for me! My hair was always tangled, especially at the nape of the neck. THis is the 2nd one I've got since I love it so much.

reviews.t: Almost Like Magic
reviews.x: Worked so well for my granddaughter that I bought her a second one to carry home with her and even bought a third for my other granddaughter to carry home. (Same review posted for the other 2 colors I bought)

reviews.t: A good solid brush
reviews.x: I'm not a brush export but I wanted to get a brush for my toddler daughters curly, wavy hair.  The brush itself is easy to hold and there's plenty of teeth and surface to comb through a lot of hair.  The selection of colors is nice as it can help be a conversation piece to a 2-year old.  While I don't find it any more or less beneficial to my wife's similar flat square brush, it's nice to have a special one for my daughter and she likes the curved design.

reviews.t: don't let the good reviews fool you
reviews.x: Sure, this brush detangles my hair...eventually. I have long, wavy hair, which is very tangled even post deep conditioning. I hoped this brush would work better than my wide-tooth comb, but it's about the same. In fact, I like it less than my comb because it's difficult to hold. The handle is very small, basically non-existent, and the brush constantly slips out of my hair because wet hair = wet brush. Wish I hadn't bought it.

reviews.t: This brush is amazing and does exactly what it advertises
reviews.x: This brush is amazing and does exactly what it advertises. I don't hear hair breakage as it glides through my hair. I purchased a different brand about 3 years ago and the brush head was too round and too big, but this one seems to be a good size and fits into a purse just fine. I bought a second one to use on my dog as she has long hair & it gets tangled very easily. She actually gets excited when it's time to brush her now.

reviews.t: Works great
reviews.x: I have medium-thick hair, and since I've gotten my hair bleached blonde a few months ago, I have been having knots in my hair after I wash it. I just started using this along with oil treatments for my hair, and this is so much better than using a regular brush. It pulls my hair less and it works the knots out a lot easier.  The brush is a very lightweight plastic, but it does what it's supposed to. Definitely recommend.

reviews.t: Good for fine, long hair.
reviews.x: I am growing my hair out after many years of keeping it above shoulder-length. Suddenly I was fighting tangles. I remembered that I'd purchased detangling brushes for my little granddaughters and so decided to try it for myself. Works well. I like the ergonomics, the color, the quality. I still have to be gentle combing out wet hair, but this works better than any of my regular brushes for the job.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brush for detangling hair gently and painlessly, especially for curly, thick, or tangle-prone hair.
Many reviewers say it works well for children and toddlers, reducing brushing struggles and tears.
Several reviewers report buying multiple brushes for themselves and family members.
A few negative reviewers say the brush leaves hair frizzy, tangled, or causes split and broken ends.
Some reviewers note the brush is not a miracle cure and may not make every knot painless or fully satisfy young children.
